title: MAQS-Way measurement conditions block (mandatory for any measurement record)
lesson: Three times in two days (scope, gate_target_basis, haystack_condition) a measurement lacked an explicit conditions block. This schema makes it structural, not vigilance.

fields.prereg_selection: verified | posthoc — did the run use the selection exactly as pre-registered?
fields.prereg_expectation: verified | mismatch | posthoc — was the numeric expectation interpretable under the run's conditions?

prereg_selfconsistency.rule: A prereg expectation line MUST bind its range to its condition: 'expected <range> under <condition>'. A range without a bound condition is RED before the GPU is spent (pre-run gate, evals/check_conditions.py).
prereg_selfconsistency.rationale: prereg-internal contradiction (expected_haystack: oracle vs expected_range_basis: full-haystack) is catchable BEFORE the run — cheaper than a post-hoc label.
